about: Farmhand's acceptance scenarios in the player's own words (the user, 2026-10-22: one test that runs each example). Each runs live with scripts/fs25_scenarios.py on whichever save is loaded (saves: the ones its world fits; 'any' for every map), and offline: tests/test_scenarios.py checks every sentence is understood by the rules alone (small-model safe) and that the mock tests named in 'covered_by' exist. 'concurrent': its requests are sent one after another without waiting for background helpers, which then must finish too. 'expect' is per request: the final status, and the reason when it matters. 'implemented': false marks a scenario whose capability is still being built; it is reported, never skipped silently.
